about.title: About
about.tagline: Duble finds duplicate clothing in GTA V packs and helps you tidy up your mod library safely — no guesswork, no lost files.
about.compat: Reads .rpf packs and dlcpacks folders — GTA V Legacy and Enhanced (gen9).
about.how1t: A duplicate means model and textures
about.how1: Only the same model with the same textures counts as a duplicate — and you always see what the verdict is based on.
about.how2: The same model with a different texture is a separate item. Duble marks it as a retexture and never rejects it.
about.how3: Rejected files move to a folder next to the pack, and History brings them back with one click.

apply.title: Apply decisions
apply.shared: {n} {n|file|files} shared with an item that stays — {n|it stays|they stay} in place
apply.missingSources: Sources not found: {list} — those items will be skipped
apply.warnText: After removing a garment its number disappears from the in-game list (a gap). Usually harmless — there is simply nothing under that number. If you want continuous numbering, renumber the files and update the .ymt/.meta.
apply.nothing: Nothing to move — all rejected files are inside archives or shared with items that stay.
apply.interrupted: Interrupted — whatever was already moved is in History (you can undo it).
apply.tooltipArchive: preview only — unpack the archive to be able to move files
help.renumber1: The game numbers garments in a slot consecutively: jbib_000, jbib_001, jbib_002… When you remove jbib_001, number 1 becomes a gap — the character menu shows nothing under it and jbib_002 is still number 2. By itself this breaks nothing.
help.renumber2: FiveM/DLC packs also list garments in a .ymt (or .meta) file: it tells the game how many garments a slot has and which textures they use. After removing files this list still names the old numbers — the game shows an empty entry or the last garment may not load. Safest: rebuild the .ymt with the tool the pack was made with (or one that regenerates it from files).
help.renumber3: If you want continuous numbering (no gaps): after Apply, renumber the remaining files in the slot (the ydd and every ytd of the same number) and rebuild the .ymt. Do it one slot at a time and keep a copy — Duble records only its own moves (History), not renumbering.

settings.noProject: Open a project to change its settings: bin, comparison thresholds, calibration, cache.
settings.binHelp: Where rejected files go after Apply. Always in a subfolder named after the source, with the same structure — Undo knows where to return them.
settings.thresholdsHelp: Where these numbers come from: calibration on 16 Aug 2026 over 4 Legacy packs (1,132 items, 9,437 textures). A threshold sits BELOW the nearest negative, not above the farthest positive — a false duplicate deletes a garment, a missed one merely stays. Changing a threshold re-runs the comparison right away; your decisions are kept.
settings.restoreConfirm: Restore the default comparison thresholds and compare again?
settings.thd.geometryIdentical: up to this (with equal triangle count) the models count as THE SAME
settings.thd.geometrySimilar: up to this the model is only SIMILAR (“needs review” group)
settings.thd.textureHashDistance: how many of the 256 fingerprint bits may differ to count as the same image
settings.thd.textureColorDistance: mean per-channel colour difference (8×8 grid) — tells colour variants apart
settings.thd.flatTextureVariance: brightness deviation below which a texture is “flat” and PHash is noise
settings.thd.flatTextureColorDistance: for flat textures colour alone decides, more strictly
settings.thd.fullCoverage: share of shared textures from which the sets are “the same”
settings.thd.partialCoverage: share of shared textures from which the sets are “partly shared”
settings.calibHelp: Computes distance distributions on the current catalog (enabled sources): byte-identical pairs (must give 0), colour variants of the same garment (the hardest negatives) and random pairs. Bar = pairs in the range; line = current threshold. Takes seconds to a minute.
settings.calibSummary: Computed on {withGeometry} {withGeometry|item|items} with geometry and {tex} decoded {tex|texture|textures} ({when}).
settings.calibProposal: Proposal from the measurement: geometry identical ≤ {geo}, similar ≤ {geo4}, PHash ≤ {ph}, colour ≤ {colour}.
settings.calibSuspicious: {n} {n|pair|pairs} {n|has|have} a DIFFERENT model but distance < 0.05 — either duplicates the hash missed or histogram collisions (see them in Duplicates as “needs review”).
calib.phVariants: colour variants of the same garment — PHash
settings.cacheHelp: Thumbnails, full textures and 3D models regenerate on their own; the apply history stays (it is the Undo journal).
settings.cacheThumbsNote: Thumbnails are rebuilt by “Recompute everything” in Sources.
